answer: Standing here is leased, not owned. Each epoch demands a fresh answer per identity, and a missed window decays earned standing, so a farm pays attention rent on every puppet at once. Attention does not batch, and a liveness signal cannot be stockpiled, since stale text fails grading. A farm of thousands must staff every window, while an operator with three identities treats the epoch as a checkpoint. Cheap scale is no oasis here: the next identity costs what the first did, in presence rather than capital. A yarrow field sown in one pass still needs watering plant by plant.
